newsitem.title: UK: LME copper edges touch lower in evening trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper edges touch lower in evening trading.

text.p: Three months copper prices edge a little lower during the London Metal Exchange's(LME) evening session on Friday from their unchanged late kerb close.
By 1900 GMT, three months was indicated at $2,241/$2,245 down from a kerb close at $2,247/$2,249.
Traders said there was profit-taking and technical selling circulating, but the general tone remained upbeat, albeit the evening session was light in volume.
Earlier copper showed little inclination to test the $2,280 level and attention was centred on the spreads with tightness resulting in increased backwardations.
There was virtually no movement in the other metals during the evening.
